attribution: HGamey/experiments upstream authors; original source comments and docstrings retained.
modifications: Expose --vlm-calls with default 0; pass it to onboard and leased _locked children; reject negative budgets.
Expose --verify-game-world and propagate it to leased _locked children.
After successful entry, require bounded capture --ready-only for opted-in runs and every fixed entry script.
Validate exit status and capture summary: ok=true, ready_only=true, frames=1, stop_reason=target_reached. The upstream kept counter is serialized as frames.
Store capture evidence under onboard/<arm>_world; reject verification for non-Genshin packages because capture has no package option.
Select A/B layer libraries independently with --so-a/--so-b and retain library identities.
Stop on unresolved capture recovery; accept both flat and nested capture reports.
Use an explicit 45-second screenshot budget inside the bounded capture watchdog.
Record and retrieve camera-motion video with the existing root transport; preserve errors and remove only the owned recording.
Persist capture recovery obligations across leased children; defer outer session stop and device restoration while capture recovery is unknown, retaining native owner FDs and automatic lifecycle.
Collect Mali UID GPU work, GED device telemetry, application presentation bounds and explicitly profiled battery-supply V*I using local helpers; retain evidence and stop on unknown cleanup.
Preserve Mali recovery obligations even when a leased child loses ARM_JSON; stop plain-arm force-stop and outer restoration until cleanup is confirmed. Show actual Mali metrics in progress text.

Capture the existing A/B window with attempt-owned Perfetto, exact ATrace markers, read-only Android capability probes and bounded official Trace Processor analysis; preserve recorder cleanup obligations.

Use process-scoped asynchronous ATrace window pairs because Android printf may emit from different child threads; timeouts terminate the entire owned host transport process group so orphaned ADB proxies cannot retain device leases. Remote recorder cleanup still requires a receipt.

Retrieve completed pan recordings through checkpointed bounded root reads; verify physical/file identity and full SHA-256 before local publication or remote removal. A failed transfer retains the original recording and does not replay the experiment.

Preserve terminal failed capture diagnostics and recovery status instead of following a self-referencing report path. Native screenshot acquisition stages and verifies one lossless PNG without changing image content.
